meta.title: Creative Style
meta.description: Want AI to write in the style of novels you love, or to develop a voice that is uniquely yours? Creative Style imports novels you like and your own original work, distils their writing patterns into a personal style profile, and lets you blend several sources into one voice. Before you write it compiles a short brief; afterwards it points out clichés, repetition and off-style sentences, and can rewrite specific spans. Off by default, no scores, no model training.
